==Statistics==
{{Item Statistics
| type = Scroll
| icon id = 4706
| name = Scroll of Enlight
| tags = {{Rare}}
| jobs = PLD
| level = 40 {{changes|Was never available during 75 cap.}}
| description = Teaches the white magic Enlight.<br/>Adds light damage to your attacks.
| notes = Damage from Enlight begins at a set point based on [[:category:Divine Magic|Divine Magic]] skill, then decreases by 1 damage per successful hit.  The effect expires automatically when the damage reaches zero.
*The formula to determine base damage on HorizonXI is the step function:  {{Changes}}<br/>Divine Magic Skill < 150: (Divine Magic Skill/30)+10 <br/>Divine Magic Skill > 150: (Divine Magic Skill/15)+5
*Provides an accuracy bonus equal to the additional effect/damage that enlight does.  The accuracy bonus currently does not show up in /checkparam.
*Activates on each hit in an attack round -- such as due to [[Double Attack]], additional hits from weapons like [[Joyeuse]], and [[Dual Wield|offhanded weapons]].
*Can be interrupted while casting this spell by attacks.
*Provides enmity +10.  
}}
